headline: D-Quant reports near-BF16 long-context accuracy with about 2.26 bits per KV value
summary: The paper proposes D-Quant, which entropy-codes KV-cache values and adjusts a small subset of quantized symbols to keep each token stream within a fixed-size container. On Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, the authors report 2.26 bits per value and RULER averages close to BF16 across 4K–128K contexts; at 128K, reported scores exceed the strongest listed low-bit baselines. The measurements are paper-reported and use NVIDIA H20 GPUs; the research desk did not run the implementation.
